stages.finding: Publication-selected B3 topology, source commit/tree/blobs, parameter lanes, state order, and deterministic FRET output frozen before SymC spectrum analysis.
Source time-grid assertion failed before solver execution or trajectory result opening; preserved as mechanical evidence.
All 15 source-native latent states reproduced over the frozen sustained-FGF trajectory within the predeclared numeric thresholds.
Finite-difference derivative route failed its frozen numerical consistency rule. Failure retained and not reclassified.

Analytic reaction-network Jacobian independently matched complex-step differentiation; 8D stoichiometric dynamic generator qualified; all frozen contexts fully FRET-observable; one or more licensed complex chi_bio factors present in both source-defined parameter lanes under common inputs.
Every FRET-visible complex-pair lane passed, but the complete 8D frozen fixed-stoichiometric-direction round-trip failed in every context.

After preserving v1 as a Limit Map, a distinct question was opened: test every natural invariant modal carrier rather than arbitrary spanning directions. Same primary amplitude-convergence rule retained.

52/64 frozen modal directions passed; 15/25 carrier-context records passed. Real-mode failures remained and two complex-pair subspaces failed one frozen negative-real direction in the FGF=250 contexts. Complete ERK Chi_bio admission remained refused.

chi_bio.claim_ceiling: Mode-specific local scalar representation class with explicit context and directional nonlinear limits; no system scalar and no biological chi=1 boundary.

Bio_Chi.reason: ERK modal layer did not earn admission under either v1 or v2.

combined_limit_map.v1_limit: Complete 8D local linear adequacy does not hold uniformly across the frozen arbitrary source-stoichiometric directions at the tested amplitudes.
combined_limit_map.v2_limit: Natural invariant modal carriers also do not show uniform local nonlinear round-trip adequacy under the stricter all-sign/all-subspace-direction rule.
combined_limit_map.shared_information: ERK local linear structure is strongly informative but its nonlinear adequacy is direction- and context-dependent at the frozen perturbation scales.
combined_limit_map.specific_v2_pattern: The only complex-pair subspace failures occur at FGF=250; many failed comparisons occur at very small relative errors and worsen again at 1e-5, consistent with a numerical-floor or stiffness interaction, but the frozen rules remain failures.

scientific_lineage_interpretation: Across this ERK lineage, the generator-derived mode-specific scalar construction transports more readily than complete modal nonlinear closure. The result supports separation of scalar, modal, and realized-system layers: success at one layer neither guarantees nor rescues another. The v1 and v2 failures are complementary limits, not contradictory analyses.
promotion_debt: No P1 confirmation has been performed.
Any future ERK modal lineage must cite both v1 and v2 failures.
A third ERK representation may not be selected solely because it is expected to remove the observed failures.
Any claim that the failures are merely numerical requires a separately frozen numerical-resolution investigation and cannot retroactively change either result.
Cross-system Bio Chi transport remains closed until an independent system earns both modal and system-layer admission.
lineage_close_rule: No third ERK modal representation is opened in this cycle. The lineage closes with scalar-class transport supported, ERK modal admission refused under two distinct qualification questions, and both limits retained.
